name: A — Aríete
prompt: Original 2D manga fantasy creature portrait on white, one head and short neck in three-quarter view facing right. Design A: a broad short-muzzled coral-orange reptile with a powerful squared ivory lower jaw, tiny narrow amber eyes deeply recessed under one thick low ivory curved brow ridge. Eyes are deliberately small and restrained, with a narrow iris strip and minimal shine. Forehead wide and short, blunt rectangular nose with two tiny nostril slits, closed firm mouth with a single discreet corner tooth. Two short thick indigo cheek fins, the near fin has a single shallow notch. The ivory brow and indigo cheek fins are taut living kite-paper structures integrated into the creature, with a few clear edges rather than many wrinkles. Strong compact neck, attentive stubborn expression, no smile. Crisp clean manga contours, flat saturated coral, ivory and indigo, one hard shadow, large quiet surfaces. No textures, gradients, realistic rendering, helmet, giant eyes, tall horns, many spikes, text or other characters. Generous margins around all parts.
note: Crânio curto e largo, mandíbula pesada, olhos mínimos sob arco de testa. As pontas do arco ficaram mais altas que o brief; pode ler como chifre e deve ser decidido. Boa leitura de força sem muita fragmentação.

name: B — Espreita
prompt: Design B: one original orange-and-ivory dragon head with a LONG, LOW, narrow rectangular snout, in profile turned slightly toward the viewer. Tiny amber eyes beneath a dark blue horizontal brow. The eye opening is a thin slit and the muzzle is long and flat, clearly different from a short-faced dragon. A single narrow ivory ridge follows the top of the nose. One long smooth dark blue cheek fin swept backward, edged with a thin gold line. Strong ivory lower jaw, closed mouth, two small nostril marks, quiet watchful expression. Short neck visible. Clean 2D manga concept art with crisp outlines, broad flat orange, ivory and dark blue color areas, one cel shadow, minimal interior lines. White background, generous margins, one portrait, no words or other objects.
note: Focinho longo e baixo, olhos pequenos e faixa lateral com vareta. A geração virou a cabeça para a esquerda e acrescentou cristas longas; não é comparação no mesmo ângulo nem ajuste aprovado. A proporção alongada muda bastante a família e pede corpo correspondente.

name: C — Tirante
prompt: Original Soulmonsters 2D manga fantasy creature head portrait C on white. Three-quarter head and short neck, no other figures. A living kite-dragon whose face is its own anatomy, shaped as a broad midnight indigo wedge tapering to a short coral triangular snout. Two broad overlapping warm ivory forehead planes meet in ONE slim dark central tension seam down the nose bridge. Tiny narrow amber eye slits recessed beneath sloping indigo brow eaves, very small iris and no rounded cartoon eyes. Firm coral jaw, ivory squared chin, mouth closed with a composed defiant expression. One temple has a broad curved ivory/indigo taut paper cheek plane with ONE small gold knotted root, opposite side has a shorter simple keel: deliberate asymmetry. Only four or five large primary facial planes, large quiet colored surfaces. Clearly a living reptilian creature, not robot or someone wearing a helmet. Coral, ivory, indigo and gold family palette, confident clean manga contour, one sharp cel shadow. No textures, repeated origami wrinkles, glossy render, armor screws, human face, text or scenery. Generous margins around complete portrait.
note: Cunha índigo com planos marfim e nó assimétrico, olhos estreitos e mandíbula coral. Melhor integração estrutural de pipa; porém pode ler como elmo. Se escolhido, esclarecer cabeça viva sem face interna removível. Crânio mais largo e pontas maiores que o brief.
